tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window ground and the slide-grid area. Text: `text`, `muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Toolbar, sidebars, inspector, transport bar, cards.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Resting controls (buttons, segmented tracks), info strips, stat tiles.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Selected row, selected segment, meter track. Do not set `live` text on it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panes and sections. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (buttons, fields, checkboxes, chips). 3:1 on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, section labels on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Healthy / running status, toggles on, timers, chorus section. In light theme use on `bg` and `surface` (4.6:1+); on `surface-2` only at 600 weight.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Preview selection ring, Audience role, checkboxes, verse section, links.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stage role, warnings, offline media, bridge section. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE text and dots on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`. Means on-air and nothing else.

tokens.name: live-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the Go Live button, LIVE tag and the 3 pt live ring. Text on it: `on-live`.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `live-fill`.

tokens.name: broadcast
tokens.usage: Broadcast role, fill/key connectors, the Simulated badge.

tokens.name: brand-a
tokens.usage: Start of the brand gradient (135°). Mark, primary button, cover.

tokens.name: brand-b
tokens.usage: End of the brand gradient.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the brand gradient and on `warning` fills.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Ground of every output preview and of stage screens. Same in both themes: outputs do not follow the operator theme.

tokens.name: lyric-ink
tokens.usage: First-language lyrics on outputs.

tokens.name: lyric-ink-2
tokens.usage: Second-language lyrics on outputs (Vietnamese in the examples). 14.7:1 on `canvas`.

tokens.name: stage-next
tokens.usage: Next-slide text on stage screens.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Lower-third plate behind broadcast lyrics. Its alpha becomes grey in the key signal.

tokens.name: role-audience
tokens.usage: Audience screens: chips, connector outlines, dots.

tokens.name: role-stage
tokens.usage: Stage screens.

tokens.name: role-broadcast
tokens.usage: Broadcast screens.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Running, verified, zero dropped frames. Deliberately not green, so it never has to be told from `live` by hue.

tokens.name: section-verse
tokens.usage: Verse label and dot in the slide grid.

tokens.name: section-chorus
tokens.usage: Chorus label and dot.

tokens.name: section-bridge
tokens.usage: Bridge, ending and tag labels.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Selected screen name, sub-pane titles. SwiftUI .title3.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels in the transport bar. SwiftUI .headline.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Captions under thumbnails, helper text. SwiftUI .subheadline.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section headers in sidebars and inspectors, in `muted`.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Frame counters, timecode, hex values, video modes.

styles.name: lyric
styles.usage: Audience first-language lyrics, `lyric-ink`, centred inside the 90% title-safe area.

styles.name: lower-third
styles.sample: My chains are gone, I’ve been set free
styles.usage: Broadcast lower third, first language. Reflow before shrinking; never below 56px.

styles.name: lower-third-2
styles.sample: Xiềng xích đã tan, tôi được tự do

styles.name: stage-current
styles.usage: Stage current lyric. Auto-fit may reduce it to 96px, no further.

styles.name: stage-timer
styles.usage: Stage clock and timers, tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside segmented tracks; ring offset of thumbnails.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in chips; between stacked list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sidebar section padding; grid gutter between thumbnails.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pane padding and toolbar side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between form columns; between groups on a board.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Sheet and board margins.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Regular buttons, fields, pop-ups (macOS regular control size).

tokens.name: transport-height
tokens.usage: Previous, Go Live, Next, Clear, Blackout, Stop.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Unified window toolbar.

tokens.name: transport-bar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom transport bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Library and playlist sidebar; resizable 240–380.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Right-hand monitors and inspector; resizable 320–440.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: LIVE and PREVIEW tags, keyboard hints, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Slide and media thumbnails, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Regular buttons, fields, list rows, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Transport buttons, connector tiles, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, status pills (half of their 20px height).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, popovers and the editor canvas. Nothing else casts a shadow.
